items.title: From Zero to First Android App
items.excerpt: My journey building and publishing a Jetpack Compose app from scratch.
items.content:
Building an app from nothing is intimidating. Here's what helped me most:

- **Pick a small scope first** — a single feature you can ship.
- **Learn Jetpack Compose basics** — state, layout, navigation.
- **Ship early** — publishing v1 teaches more than perfecting v0.

> The best way to learn is to build something real.

I wrote about the full journey including the mistakes I made along the way.

items.title: Why I Love Clean Architecture
items.excerpt: How separating concerns keeps your codebase sane as projects grow.
items.content:
Clean Architecture separates your app into layers so each part has one job:

1. **Domain** — business rules, no framework.
2. **Data** — repositories, remote/local sources.
3. **Presentation** — UI, ViewModels, state.

When a project grows, this structure keeps changes predictable and testable. It costs a bit more setup upfront, but it pays off fast.

items.title: Next.js + GitHub Pages in 10 Minutes
items.excerpt: Deploying a static Next.js site to GitHub Pages with GitHub Actions.
items.content:
Deploying Next.js to GitHub Pages is easier than it looks:

1. Set `output: 'export'` in `next.config.ts`.
2. Add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs `pnpm build`.
3. Deploy the `out/` folder to `gh-pages`.

Add a `.nojekyll` file so static files are served correctly. Done — your site is live on GitHub Pages.
